title: Safe Subscript Extension
hints: Subscripts can have argument labels, and you can add them in an extension.
In `extension Collection`, return `self[index]` only if `indices.contains(index)`, else `nil`.
`subscript(safe index: Index) -> Element? { indices.contains(index) ? self[index] : nil }` and `indices.map { items[safe: $0] }`.
